mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.avid, v.title, v.cover_url, v.total_duration, v.episode_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.play_count) FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0), 0) AS play_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.favorite_count) FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0), 0) AS favorite_count, v.is_ongoing, v.create_time, v.user_id, c.name AS category_name, u.nike_name, u.avatar, u.uid FROM public.video_info v LEFT JOIN public.category c ON v.category_id = c.id AND c.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN public.user_info u ON v.user_id = u.id WHERE v.is_delete = 0 AND v.video_status = 2 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0 AND e.review_status = 1) >= 1 ORDER BY ${orderColumn} DESC

SELECT v.id, v.avid, v.title, v.cover_url, v.total_duration, v.episode_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.play_count) FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0), 0) AS play_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.favorite_count) FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0), 0) AS favorite_count, (SELECT e.avid FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0 AND e.review_status = 1 ORDER BY e.episode_number DESC LIMIT 1) AS episode_avid, v.is_ongoing, v.create_time, v.user_id, c.name AS category_name, u.nike_name, u.avatar, u.uid FROM public.video_info v LEFT JOIN public.category c ON v.category_id = c.id AND c.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN public.user_info u ON v.user_id = u.id WHERE v.is_delete = 0 AND v.video_status = 2 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0 AND e.review_status = 1) >= 1 AND v.user_id IN (SELECT f.follow_user_id FROM public.user_follow f WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.is_delete = 0) ORDER BY v.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT v.id, v.avid, v.title, v.description, v.category_id, v.cover_url, v.total_duration, v.episode_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.play_count) FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0), 0) AS play_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.favorite_count) FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0), 0) AS favorite_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.like_count) FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0), 0) AS like_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.coin_count) FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0), 0) AS coin_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.viewer_count) FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0), 0) AS viewer_count, v.user_id, v.is_ongoing, v.video_status, v.create_time, v.update_time, c.name AS category_name, u.user_name, u.nike_name, u.avatar, u.uid FROM public.video_info v LEFT JOIN public.category c ON v.category_id = c.id AND c.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN public.user_info u ON v.user_id = u.id WHERE v.id = #{id} AND v.is_delete = 0

SELECT v.id, v.avid, v.title, v.description, v.category_id, v.cover_url, v.total_duration, v.episode_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.play_count) FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0), 0) AS play_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.favorite_count) FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0), 0) AS favorite_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.like_count) FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0), 0) AS like_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.coin_count) FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0), 0) AS coin_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.viewer_count) FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0), 0) AS viewer_count, v.user_id, v.is_ongoing, v.video_status, v.create_time, v.update_time, c.name AS category_name, u.user_name, u.nike_name, u.avatar, u.uid FROM public.video_info v LEFT JOIN public.category c ON v.category_id = c.id AND c.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN public.user_info u ON v.user_id = u.id WHERE v.avid = #{avid} AND v.is_delete = 0

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN vs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN vs = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS partial_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN vs = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN video_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS draft_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN video_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_publish_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN video_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS published_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN video_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS removed_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN create_date = CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today_new_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN create_date = CURRENT_DATE - 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS yesterday_new_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN vs = 0 AND create_date = CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today_pending_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN vs = 0 AND create_date = CURRENT_DATE - 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS yesterday_pending_count FROM ( SELECT v.id, v.video_status, v.create_time::date AS create_date, (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN e.review_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*) THEN 0 WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN e.review_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0) AS vs FROM public.video_info v WHERE v.is_delete = 0 ) t

SELECT CAST(v.category_id AS BIGINT) AS category_id, COUNT(*) AS video_count FROM public.video_info v WHERE v.is_delete = 0 AND v.category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY v.category_id ORDER BY video_count DESC

SELECT v.id, v.avid, v.title, v.cover_url, v.total_duration, v.episode_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.play_count) FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0), 0) AS play_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.favorite_count) FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0), 0) AS favorite_count, v.is_ongoing, v.video_status, v.create_time, c.name AS category_name, u.nike_name, u.avatar, u.uid, t.vs AS review_status FROM public.video_info v LEFT JOIN public.category c ON v.category_id = c.id AND c.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN public.user_info u ON v.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN ( SELECT v2.id, (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN e.review_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*) THEN 0 WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN e.review_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v2.id AND e.is_delete = 0) AS vs FROM public.video_info v2 WHERE v2.is_delete = 0 ) t ON t.id = v.id AND (t.vs IN (0, 1) or v.video_status= 1)
v.is_delete = 0
AND v.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
AND u.nike_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{nickName}, '%')
ORDER BY v.create_time DESC

SELECT create_time::date AS "date", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM public.video_info WHERE is_delete = 0 AND create_time::date >= #{startDate} AND create_time::date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY create_time::date ORDER BY "date"
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.video_info WHERE is_delete = 0 AND create_time::date = CURRENT_DATE

SELECT v.create_time::date AS "date", v.category_id AS "categoryId", COALESCE(c.name, '未分类') AS "categoryName", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM public.video_info v LEFT JOIN public.category c ON v.category_id = c.id AND c.is_delete = 0 WHERE v.is_delete = 0 AND v.create_time::date >= #{startDate} AND v.create_time::date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY v.create_time::date, v.category_id, c.name ORDER BY v.category_id, v.create_time::date
